mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and primaquine may inhibit CYP2D6 activity, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine levels; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS effects and primaquine carries hemolytic risk in G6PD deficiency.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (akathisia, parkinsonism, sedation) and assess G6PD status before primaquine use; consider dose adjustment of deutetrabenazine if clinically indicated.
